criterion: boundary values / empty or malformed inputs
finding: A debaters map whose roles are one string, such as {"W1": "pro"}, silently becomes the character set {p,r,o}, so no draft of that item is ever released.
why: read_finished refuses a string for `stages` but not for a role list, so the same slip fails silently here and the debate waits for ever with no error.
fix: Raise KnowledgeError when a roles value is a str, as is already done for `stages`.
evidence: `roles = {item: set(names) for item, names in (debaters or {}).items()}` versus the `isinstance(stages, str)` guard at line 195

finding: The temporary file is written before the try/finally, so a failed write (disk full, interrupted) leaves a partial `.<name>.<uuid>.tmp` in the store, and nothing removes it.
why: The cleanup in `finally` covers only the link or replace step, so a failure of write_text leaves a stray file in a store that is meant to hold only entries.
fix: Move the `tmp.write_text(...)` call inside the existing try block so the finally clause removes the temporary file.

finding: No test sets `verdict` outside a debate, so the verdict half of the 'stay empty outside a debate' guard is unpinned.
why: Dropping `entry.get("verdict") is not None` from the guard at knowledge.py:83 leaves every test green, because the test only exercises `reason`, `work_item` and `debate_step`.
fix: Add `write(tmp_path, verdict="AGREE")` expecting KnowledgeError match="verdict" to this test; split the four behaviours into separate cases.
evidence: test_debate_fields_stay_empty_outside_a_debate raises only for reason=, work_item=, debate_step=; production line 83: `if entry.get("verdict") is not None or entry.get("reason") is not None:`.

finding: No damaged-file case covers a filename that disagrees with the entry's author/time, or an entry with an extra field; both _load guards are unpinned.
why: Removing the filename check (knowledge.py:138) or the exact-fields check (knowledge.py:135) would not fail any test.
fix: Add parametrized cases: a valid entry copied under another author/time filename, and a valid entry plus an extra key; assert both are skipped and reported.
evidence: parametrize list is ["{not json", "[]", '{"format_version": 1, "author": "a2"}']; production lines 135 `if sorted(data) != sorted(FIELDS + ("format_version",))` and 138 `!= path` have no dedicated case.

finding: The 'nothing is promoted' assertion checks only that no public function name contains 'promot'; the test name implies a stronger proof than it gives.
why: A function that copies an entry to another record under any other name passes, so AC-019/ADR-0018 is asserted by a name grep, not by behaviour.
fix: Keep the file-location assertion as the proof and drop or rename the name-grep line; or assert the exact public name set.
evidence: `assert not any("promot" in name.lower() for name in public)`
